title: Chanina ben Yonah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Yalkut, Malachi, section 589. This is a scribal error: it should read Rabbi Chanina, son of Rabbi Abbahu, as the statement appears in Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 4:1.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The change of father from Yonah to Abbahu is Hyman’s proposed textual correction.

The checked Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 589 names Rabbi Chanina son of Rabbi Yonah, while the parallel in Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 4:1 names Rabbi Chanina son of Rabbi Abbahu. Hyman calls the former a textual error and says it should read the latter. Both witness forms are retained; the comparison does not change the Hebrew or establish a genealogical identification.
